name: percussion-and-low-brass
style: Grave film underscore led by a massed drum ensemble, instrumental, pulse fixed at 86 BPM from first bar to last. Concert bass drums, deep frame drums and tuned toms play a slow, weighty pattern with whole empty beats left hanging between strikes. Low horns and bass trombones reply in brief dark punches, minor, never a tune. Starts on a single enormous drum strike with a long decay, then spaced hits around open air, then a tom roll building in volume, then a sustained low brass chord resting over a quiet drum rumble. Sub and low end weighty, upper mids kept bare so speech sits on top. Serious, ominous, unhurried. No vocals.
exclude: vocals, choir, chant, humming, spoken word, string melody, violin lead, synth lead, arpeggiator, fanfare, trumpet solo, heroic theme, triumphant, comedic, quirky, drum machine, EDM, tempo change, jazz, swing, piano lead
